faqHeading: Questions About Appliance Repair in Austin

faq.q: How fast can a technician get to my home in Austin?
faq.a: Most Austin calls booked before noon get a same-day visit, and the rest get the first slot the next morning.

faq.q: Which appliance brands do you repair?
faq.a: We repair the major household brands, including Whirlpool, Samsung, LG, GE, Frigidaire, Maytag and KitchenAid, plus Sub-Zero built-ins.
We serve Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock and Georgetown from our Austin shop.

faq.q: What happens on the first visit?
faq.a: The technician diagnoses the problem, gives you a written price and fixes it on the spot once you approve, in most cases with parts from the van.

faq.q: Do you work on premium and built-in appliances?
faq.a: Yes. Premium and built-in appliances, including Sub-Zero, are part of our everyday work.

faqClosing: Still have a question about your appliance? Our FAQ page covers pricing, scheduling and what happens on the visit.

closing.h2: The Fix Is One Call Away
closing.body: From a Sub-Zero built-in to an everyday dryer that will not heat, you get an honest diagnosis, a written price and a repair backed for 90 days.
